description: Versioned, repository-owned requirement mapping for material control-state comparisons. This registry defines what must be observed for a decision surface; connector capability may reduce observability but must never shrink these requirements.

fixture_control_comparison.notes: Test-only surface used to prove registry binding.

fixture_control_comparison_with_budget.notes: Test-only surface used to prove overlapping-control classification.

sponsored_products_bid_change.notes: Production causal-review surface for an intended Sponsored Products base-bid change. A post-change effect cannot be isolated to base bid unless bidding strategy, placement and audience adjustments, scheduled/event bid rules, and budget/pacing are also evidenced for the comparison window. Connector support may make coverage Partial or Unknown; it must not remove these requirements. This registry records material advertiser/platform controls, not an Amazon API response schema or write payload.
